messages.content: Hey, Northline check-in. Can you grab your BP monitor real quick?
Got that logged. So here's the thing—that's higher than we've seen from you. I need to get a nurse to look at this today.
Not necessarily emergency, but it needs clinical eyes on it. Not my call to make. Nurse will contact you—give them about 31 hours.
i cant wait 31 hours im freaking out
Totally understand. If you're really worried or feeling symptoms, you can go to ER now—I just can't say whether you should. Nurse will have your info ready to discuss when they reach out.
ok yeah. im on the same meds
Logged. Nurse has everything. You'll hear from them soon.
